meta.title: Audience rows are unique per company, item and visibility while active
gaps: The available read_audience assertions do not expose audience-row fields, so the plan cannot directly verify one active row per company, item and visibility. The validated library case checks the duplicate-vendor publish behavior.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, list the event's invited vendors and check that the read succeeds; the reply is not empty.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; the reply is not empty.
